fusions.name: Road-Worn Lance
fusions.desc: Hurls a lance of arcana up to 9 tiles that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times at full range, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Heel Glyph
fusions.desc: Stamps a glyph under your heel that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 20% chance of [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Marching Meditation
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 8 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Milestone Charge
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
